enderutilities.tooltip.placementproperti: |lf§f*** Placement Properties ***§r|lf- (Shift +) Toggle key to change property selection|lf- Shift/Ctrl/Alt + scroll to change the value
enderutilities.gui.label.portalpanel.dye: Place a dye here to apply a color|lfto the button and the created portal
enderutilities.gui.infoarea.portalpanel: - You can add a dye per destination in the Dye slot|lf- The dye will change the created portal's color (cosmetic only!)|lf- The destination location comes from the Link Crystal when a portal is activated|lf- A Portal Panel must be placed ON a Portal Frame block,|lf  which is connected to a valid portal "frame loop" via|lf  a "continuous path" of Portal Frame blocks|lf  (diagonal connection is not enough)|lf- The portal frame loop itself however can also contain diagonal corners|lf- The maximum sizes for the portal forming algorithm are configurable|lf  (see the config file or the in-game config menu)
enderutilities.gui.infoarea.inventoryswa: - Can swap the player's inventory with the|lf  currently selected memory card's contents|lf- Player inventory slots marked as blue|lf  are enabled for swap operation|lf- Middle click to toggle individual slots|lf- In Cycle mode changing the selected card|lf  effectively does 'swap + change card + swap',|lf  which allows quickly cycling through multiple|lf  sets of items
enderutilities.gui.infoarea.memory_chest: - Middle click to lock the current item type for the slot|lf- You can also middle click (and/or drag)|lf  with items in cursor to do it faster|lf- Only that type of item can enter an empty slot|lf- A Private chest can't be opened by others,|lf  and it is also unbreakable
enderutilities.gui.label.tool_workstatio: Use empty name to reset to default
enderutilities.gui.label.enderinfuser.in: Ender Pearls or Eyes of Ender
enderutilities.tooltip.item.usetoolworks: Use the Tool Workstation to add or remove modules
enderutilities.tooltips.itemlocationboun: - Sneak + right click to bind|lf- Alt + Shift + Toggle mode: Store the players's|lf  current position, including the yaw/pitch rotations|lf- Ctrl (+ Shift) + Toggle/scroll: Change selected Link Crystal|lf- Alt + Toggle: Toggle privacy mode on selected Link Crystal
enderutilities.chat.message.nolinkcrysta: Install a Link Crystal in a Tool Workstation first

enderutilities.chat.message.enderbag.unb: Bind the bag to a vanilla Ender Chest first (sneak + right click)
enderutilities.chat.message.enderbag.not: The Ender Bag only opens vanilla Ender Chests
item.enderutilities.enderlasso.tooltips: - Shift + Toggle: Toggle Bind Locking|lf  (prevents accidentally binding)|lf- Right click to teleport mobs|lf- Add a Jailer module to prevent mobs from despawning|lf- Needs Link Crystals to store locations|lf- Needs an Ender Capacitor for power
item.enderutilities.enderbag.tooltips: - Sneak + right click to bind to a vanilla Ender Chest|lf- Ctrl (+ Shift) + Scroll: Change selected Link Crystal|lf- Doesn't currently work with other inventories|lf  because an event previously needed for the bag was removed in 1.10|lf  (new functionality is planned)
item.enderutilities.linkcrystal_0.toolti: - Sneak + right click to bind to a location|lf- Alt + Shift + Toggle mode: Store the players's|lf  current position, INCLUDING the yaw/pitch rotations|lf- Alt + Toggle mode to toggle public/private|lf- Tip: Rename in an anvil; the name is usually|lf  shown after the container item's name
item.enderutilities.linkcrystal_1.toolti: - Sneak + right click to bind to a block|lf- Alt + Toggle mode to toggle public/private|lf- Tip: Rename in an anvil; the name is usually|lf  shown after the container item's name
item.enderutilities.linkcrystal_2.toolti: - Allows pairing the Portals into pairs,|lf   instead of the normal arbitrary destination location|lf- Sneak + right click on a EnU Portal block to bind|lf  (Portal block means the blocks that are created when a Portal is activated)
item.enderutilities.endercapacitor_0.too: - Right click an Ender Crystal to charge (in The End)|lf- Or use an Ender Infuser|lf- Or build an Energy Bridge
item.enderutilities.endercapacitor_1.too: - Right click an Ender Crystal to charge (in The End)|lf- Or use an Ender Infuser|lf- Or build an Energy Bridge
item.enderutilities.endercapacitor_2.too: - Right click an Ender Crystal to charge (in The End)|lf- Or use an Ender Infuser|lf- Or build an Energy Bridge
item.enderutilities.enderpart_jailer.too: - Rightclick a mob to prevent it from despawning|lf- Can be installed in some modular items|lf   to give them the same ability|lf- When installed in modular items, it doesn't get|lf   used up like it does when right clicking
item.enderutilities.enderpart_endercore_: - Right click an Ender Crystal to activate (in The End)
- To obtain this item:|lf   Right click an Ender Crystal (in The End, the entity|lf   on top of the obsidian pillars) with an Inactive Ender Core
- Right click an Ender Crystal to activate (in The End)
- To obtain this item:|lf   Right click an Ender Crystal (in The End, the entity|lf   on top of the obsidian pillars) with an Inactive Ender Core
block.enderutilities.tool_workstation.to: - Used to access/change the modules in modular items|lf- Can also rename any item for free
block.enderutilities.ender_infuser.toolt: - Can charge the Ender Capacitors|lf- Use Ender Pearls or Eyes of Ender as "fuel"|lf- One of the three charging options atm
block.enderutilities.energy_bridge_trans: - An active Energy Bridge gives automatic|lf  Ender Capacitor recharging, when the capacitor is|lf  installed in a modular item|lf  and the item is in the player's inventory|lf- You need one Transmitter in The End|lf- It doesn't need to be chunk loaded|lf  (it doesn't actually actively do anything)|lf- Build the Transmitter around an Ender Crystal|lf  (on top of the Obsidian pillars in The End)|lf- Leave two blocks of air above the Crystal|lf  and then place the Transmitter|lf- Place four Resonators on the same level as|lf  the Ender Crystal, two blocks of air between them|lf- The Resonators must face the Crystal|lf  (place them when looking out)|lf- There can only be transparent blocks above|lf  the Transmitter all the way up to the sky|lf- There must not be any blocks|lf  between the Resonators and/or the center
block.enderutilities.energy_bridge_recei: - An active Energy Bridge gives automatic|lf  Ender Capacitor recharging, when the capacitor is|lf  installed in a modular item|lf  and the item is in the player's inventory|lf- You need one Receiver in each dimension you|lf  want the recharging to work in|lf- It doesn't need to be chunk loaded|lf  (it doesn't actually actively do anything)|lf- Place the Receiver in the middle|lf- Place four Resonators on the same level as|lf  the Receiver, two blocks of air between them|lf- The Resonators must face the Receiver|lf  (place them when looking out)|lf- There can only be transparent blocks above|lf  and below the Receiver all the way down|lf  to Bedrock and up to the sky|lf- There must not be any blocks|lf  between the Resonators and/or the Receiver
block.enderutilities.energy_bridge_reson: - See the description for the Transmitter and Receiver|lf- There must only be air "between" the Resonators|lf  (ie. where the beams will form, diagonally between Resonators|lf  and between the Resonators and the Receiver)
item.enderutilities.enderpart_enderrelic: - Spawns a new Ender Crystal|lf- Use on an Obsidian block on top of|lf  the obsidian pillars in The End|lf- In The End, it requires at least a 3x3x6 base of Obsidian|lf- Might be dangerous to your health...|lf- Can also spawn decorative Ender Crystals|lf  in other dimensions (no special requirements there)
item.enderutilities.enderpart_endercore_: - Right click an Ender Crystal to activate (in The End)
- To obtain this item:|lf   Right click an Ender Crystal (in The End, the entity|lf   on top of the obsidian pillars) with an Inactive Ender Core
item.enderutilities.enderpart_creative_b: - Can be installed to the Ender Pickaxe/Axe/Shovel|lf- Allows "creative-like" block breaking, meaning|lf  that blocks break instantly, but there is a small delay|lf  after each block, so that you don't accidentally|lf  destroy half your base when trying to break one block
item.enderutilities.enderpart_memorycard: - Can store items in stacks up to 2^(bits) = 64|lf- Right click to toggle Public/Private|lf- Sneak + right click to clear owner data
- Can store items in stacks up to 2^(bits) = 256|lf- Right click to toggle Public/Private|lf- Sneak + right click to clear owner data
- Can store items in stacks up to 2^(bits) = 1024|lf- Right click to toggle Public/Private|lf- Sneak + right click to clear owner data
- Can store items in stacks up to 2^(bits) = 4096|lf- Right click to toggle Public/Private|lf- Sneak + right click to clear owner data
item.enderutilities.enderpart_storage_ke: - Right click on (some) storage blocks to lock the slots
- Right click on (some) storage blocks to|lf  easily toggle the Creative mode on them
item.enderutilities.enderporter.tooltips: - Shift + Toggle: Toggle Bind Locking|lf  (prevents accidentally binding)|lf- Can teleport the player or another|lf  entity inside the same dimension|lf- Self-TP: Hold right click until "charged", then release|lf- TP others: Sneak + left click the target|lf  (if the target is a player, they must sneak too)|lf- Needs Link Crystals to store locations|lf- Needs an Ender Capacitor for power
item.enderutilities.enderporter_advanced: - Shift + Toggle: Toggle Bind Locking|lf  (prevents accidentally binding)|lf- Can teleport the player or another|lf  entity cross-dimensionally|lf- Self-TP: Hold right click until "charged", then release|lf- TP others: Sneak + left click the target|lf  (if the target is a player, they must sneak too)|lf- Needs Link Crystals to store locations|lf- Needs an Ender Capacitor for power
item.enderutilities.icemelter_basic.tool: - Melts Ice into a still water source block|lf- Make Ice great again!
item.enderutilities.icemelter_super.tool: - Melts Ice into a still water source block,|lf  without even causing a block update!|lf- Water curtains Ahoy!
item.enderutilities.pet_contract_blank.t: - Allows transferring the ownership of tameable mobs|lf- The owner must right click the mob to "sign the contract"|lf- Another player can then claim ownership of that mob|lf   by right clicking it with the signed contract
item.enderutilities.mobharness.tooltips: - Right click a mob to ride it|lf- Sneak + right click to 'store' a mob,|lf  then sneak + right click another mob to mount|lf  the first one on top of the second one|lf- Sneak + right click twice on the same mob|lf  to mount it on top of yourself|lf- Sneak + right click a mob that is riding|lf  something to dismount it|lf- Look down and sneak + right click|lf  to clear a 'binding'|lf- Look up and sneak + right click|lf  to dismount the mob riding you
item.enderutilities.syringe_passifier.to: - Passifies mobs, by removing their target AI tasks|lf- If anything attacks a passified mob, it will|lf   "become angry" and return to its normal hostile state
item.enderutilities.ruler.tooltips: Measure distances and visualize positions|lf- Left/right click to set start/end position|lf- Sneak to target the block, not the empty space|lf- Shift + scroll: Cycle selected point|lf- Ctrl + scroll: Cycle selected Memory Card|lf- Alt + Toggle: Toggle render when unselected|lf- Ctrl + Alt + Toggle: Toggle distance mode|lf- Alt + Shift + Toggle: Toggle render all points|lf- Just Toggle: Toggle "render with all" for selected point
enderutilities.chat.message.mobharness.t: Target entity not found or out of range (max 64 blocks)
item.enderutilities.enderarrow.tooltips: - Left click a mob to randomly teleport it|lf- Used as ammo for the Ender Bow
block.enderutilities.ender_elevator.tool: - Jump to go to the elevator above|lf- Sneak to go to the elevator below|lf- Color must match|lf- Dye to change color
item.enderutilities.enderbow.tooltips: - Toggle mode key to switch between TP Target/TP Self|lf- Shift + Toggle: Toggle Bind Locking|lf- Needs Link Crystals to store locations|lf- Needs an Ender Capacitor for power
item.enderutilities.enderbucket.tooltips: - Toggle key: Cycle Normal / Fill / Drain / Bind|lf- Shift + Toggle: Use a linked tank|lf- Bind mode + sneak + right click a tank to bind
item.enderutilities.chairwand.tooltips: - Can spawn invisible "chair entities" that you can sit on|lf- Allows you to sit on your fancy custom C&B chairs for example|lf- Shift + scroll: Change spawned entity width|lf- Alt + scroll: Change spawned entity height|lf- Right click on a block to spawn a new chair entity|lf- Left click to kill the clicked-on chair entity
item.enderutilities.builderswand.tooltip: - Can build with blocks from the player's or a linked external inventory|lf- Ctrl + scroll: Change mode|lf- Alt + scroll: Change the selected block type or the selected template/area|lf- Left click: set/unset primary position|lf- Two-corner modes: right click to set 2nd position or sneak + scroll while looking in a direction|lf- Sneak + clicking sets the position inside a block (this is only available in modes without block binding)|lf- Sneak + left click: Store the block type (where applicable)|lf- Shift + scroll: Change area dimensions in the looking direction (the primary position must be set for this!)|lf- Shift + Toggle (build modes): Toggle "move position after building"|lf- Alt + Toggle (some build modes): Toggle Replace on/off|lf- Shift + Toggle (area modes): Set area mirroring|lf- Shift + Toggle (Replace 3D): Toggle block type binding mode|lf- Ctrl + Alt + Toggle (Extend Continuous): Toggle "allow diagonals"|lf- Ctrl + Alt + Toggle (Paste): Toggle replace blocks|lf- Ctrl + Alt + Toggle (Delete): Toggle kill/remove entities|lf- Alt + Shift + Toggle: Toggle ghost block rendering|lf- Toggle: Flip the area around the looking axis|lf- Toggle (Copy mode): (Re-)name the current template|lf- Toggle (Paste/Delete modes): Set the area rotation to the current looking direction|lf- Toggle (Replace mode): Switch between Single/Area mode|lf- Ctrl + Alt + Shift + Scroll: Cycle selected Link Crystal|lf- Ctrl + Alt + Shift + Toggle (Copy): Toggle Chisels & Bits cross-world saving ON/OFF|lf  (leave it OFF unless you need to transfer builds into a separate world using the templates!)|lf- Alt + Shift + Scroll (Stack): Change the stack grid dimensions|lf- Alt + Shift + Scroll (Replace 3D): Change the replaced block type selection|lf- Sneak + right click on inventories to bind|lf- Ctrl + right click on air to place a helper block|lf- Saved templates are named by a unique ID generated for each wand
item.enderutilities.dolly.tooltips: - Can pick up and move blocks that have an inventory|lf- In Creative mode it can move any block
item.enderutilities.portalscaler.tooltip: - Right click inside a Nether Portal to travel with a custom scale|lf- Right click portal blocks to extinguish them|lf- Right click obsidian to light a portal
item.enderutilities.nullifier.tooltips: - 9 slots, each can store 1024 items|lf- Automatically voids matching pickups when full|lf- Toggle: open GUI|lf- Shift + Toggle: disable
item.enderutilities.quickstacker.tooltip: - Toggle to quick-stack into nearby inventories|lf- Works while not selected|lf- Sneak + right click a container to stack into it
item.enderutilities.pickupmanager.toolti: - Controls which items can be picked up|lf- Can transport pickups to a bound inventory, or filter what the player may pick up|lf- Enable transport/inventory filters in the GUI; they start disabled|lf- Toggle key: lock/unlock the manager|lf- Shift + Toggle/scroll: cycle filter preset|lf- Sneak + right click: bind a Block Link Crystal to an inventory|lf- Needs Block Link Crystals; add an Ender Capacitor in a Tool Workstation to send items
item.enderutilities.inventoryswapper.too: - Swaps the player's inventory with the selected Memory Card|lf- Toggle to swap even while unselected
item.enderutilities.livingmanipulator.to: - Can store and release mobs|lf- Ctrl + (Shift +) Toggle/scroll: Cycle selected Memory Card|lf- Shift + Toggle/scroll: Cycle selected mob|lf- Toggle key: Change mode (Normal/Capture only/Release only)|lf- If a Jailer module is installed, then the released mobs|lf   don't despawn like they might normally (for example hostiles)
item.enderutilities.handybag.tooltips: - Portable extra inventory stored on Memory Cards|lf- Toggle: pickup mode|lf- Shift + Toggle: lock
item.enderutilities.handybag_large.toolt: - Larger portable extra inventory|lf- Toggle: pickup mode|lf- Shift + Toggle: lock
item.enderutilities.endertool_enderpicka: - Toggle: normal/fast mining|lf- Shift + Toggle: drop handling mode|lf- The tool never breaks completely
item.enderutilities.endertool_enderaxe.t: - Toggle: normal/fast mining|lf- Shift + Toggle: drop handling mode|lf- The tool never breaks completely
item.enderutilities.endertool_endershove: - Toggle: normal/fast mining|lf- Shift + Toggle: drop handling mode|lf- The tool never breaks completely
item.enderutilities.endertool_enderhoe.t: - Toggle: 1x1 / 3x3 tilling in the original|lf- Shift + Toggle: inventory mode
item.enderutilities.endersword.tooltips: - Shift + Toggle: drop/summon mode|lf- The sword never breaks completely
item.enderutilities.void_pickaxe.tooltip: - Destroyed blocks drop nothing, not even inventory contents|lf- Also works in Creative mode|lf- Add an Efficiency V enchant for|lf  insta-mining of most blocks in the Fast mode|lf- Toggle key: Change between Normal and Fast mode
enderutilities.gui.infoarea.pickupmanage: - Can control what the player is allowed to pick up|lf- Can also directly transport items to a remote inventory|lf- The transport filters are checked first|lf- If they are disabled, or the item is not allowed there|lf  then the Inventory filters are checked next|lf- The transport filters determine which items will get transported on pickup|lf- The Inventory filters determine which items the player can pick up,|lf  assuming the item didn't get transported|lf- Note: Needs a capacitor to transport items! (add in a Tool Workstation)
enderutilities.gui.infoarea.barrel: - Right click with a Barrel Label to apply a label to that side|lf- Add a Barrel Structural Upgrade to keep contents when broken|lf- Each Barrel Capacity Upgrade adds %d stacks of capacity|lf- Middle click (items in cursor or slot): lock the slot to that item|lf- Shift + Middle click (in Creative): Fill stack (> 1 item in cursor)|lf  or cycle the stack size in x10 increments (1 item in cursor)|lf- The Barrel can also be (un-)locked with a Storage Key
enderutilities.chat.message.memorycard.f: The selected Memory Card is full
enderutilities.configuration.title: Ender Utilities Reforged
block.enderutilities.asu.tooltips: - Adjustable number of slots, 1 to 27|lf- Adjustable max stack size, up to 1024
block.enderutilities.barrel.tooltips: - Sneak + right click to open the GUI|lf- Middle click (pick block) with an empty main hand|lf   and a block in the offhand to apply camouflage|lf- Sneak while doing that to remove the camouflage
block.enderutilities.draw_bridge.tooltip: - Extends or contracts a line of blocks|lf- Max length is 64 for normal, 32 for Advanced|lf- Advanced version can use different blocks for each position|lf- Can be camouflaged by right clicking with an empty main hand,|lf  while holding the camo block in the off hand|lf- Sneak + right click with an empty hand to remove the camo block
block.enderutilities.ender_furnace.toolt: - A lot faster than a vanilla furnace|lf  (3 seconds per item in normal mode, 1 second in fast)|lf- Can use Ender Pearls, Eyes of Ender and Blaze Powder|lf  as fuel in addition to the normal furnace fuels|lf- Can also use lava as fuel from fluid containers|lf  such as the Ender Bucket or portable tanks|lf- Can operate without fuel (1 item per 60 seconds)|lf- Slow mode cooks 1.5x the items per fuel|lf  compared to a vanilla furnace|lf- Fast mode uses fuel 6x faster than slow mode over time|lf  (= 0.75x the items per fuel vs. vanilla)|lf- Can output directly to the owner's vanilla Ender Chest
block.enderutilities.floor_cracked.toolt: - Bad quality floor...|lf- Items and XP orbs will slip through the cracks
block.enderutilities.inserter.tooltips: - Sort of like a pipe, but not really a pipe|lf- Will try to insert items to enabled sides first|lf- Will then fall back to inserting items to its front side|lf- If multiple sides are enabled, will cycle them in order|lf  (= evenly distributes the items)|lf- Sneak + right click with an empty hand to toggle the side outputs
block.enderutilities.inserter_filtered.t: - Sort of like a pipe, but not really a pipe|lf- Will try to insert items to enabled sides first|lf- Will then fall back to inserting items to its front side|lf- If multiple sides are enabled, will cycle them in order|lf  (= evenly distributes the items)|lf- Sneak + right click with an empty hand to toggle the side outputs|lf- Has filters for controlling what is allowed on the side outputs|lf- Items not allowed through the filters go to the front side|lf- The filters are (at least for now) common for all sides
block.enderutilities.creation_station.to: - Combines two crafting tables, two furnaces and some modular storage|lf- Has recipe memory, quick fill crafting grids etc. functionality
block.enderutilities.quick_stacker_advan: - A more configurable, stationary version of Quick Stacker
block.enderutilities.molecular_exciter.t: - Turns blocks infront of itself into falling|lf  blocks on redstone pulse or block update|lf- Needs a redstone signal to be active
block.enderutilities.msu.tooltips: - 1 slot, which can store large amounts of items|lf- Middle click the slots in creative mode to fill/clear the slot|lf  - 1 item in cursor => grow the stack size by x10|lf  - More than 1 item in cursor => fill/clear the slot
block.enderutilities.msu_bundle.tooltips: - 9 slots, which can store large amounts of items|lf- Middle click the slots in creative mode to fill/clear the slot|lf  - 1 item in cursor => grow the stack size by x10|lf  - More than 1 item in cursor => fill/clear the slot
block.enderutilities.phasing.tooltips: - Changes state between solid and non-solid based on redstone signal
block.enderutilities.phasing_inverted.to: - Changes state between solid and non-solid based on redstone signal
block.enderutilities.frame.tooltips: - The portal can be any shape or size|lf  (within reason, there are configurable limits)|lf- It just needs to form a closed loop for the frame|lf- Can be camouflaged by right clicking with an empty main hand,|lf  while holding the camo block in the off hand|lf- Sneak + right click with an empty hand to remove the camo block
block.enderutilities.portal_panel.toolti: - Used to activate a Portal made of Portal Frame blocks|lf- The panel must be placed on a Portal Frame block|lf- That frame must connect to the actual portal frame loop/rim|lf  via a _continuous_ "path" of Portal Frame blocks|lf  (no diagonal gaps allowed in it)|lf- However the portal frame rim itself can have "diagonal corners"|lf- Uses either Location or Portal type Link Crystals for the destination
block.enderutilities.sound_block.tooltip: - Yes, it plays sounds...|lf- Select any sound from the registered sounds|lf- Adjustable pitch and volume
block.enderutilities.memory_chest.toolti: Each slot can be locked to an item type
block.enderutilities.handy_chest.tooltip: - Easier inventory management and lots|lf  of storage space|lf- Middle click to swap two large stacks|lf- Shift + click a move button|lf  to set it as the quick action|lf- Double-left-click the chest to|lf  execute the selected quick action|lf- The owner of a Memory Card can|lf  right click the card selection button to lock|lf  that card into the slot, so nobody else can|lf  take the card itself out of that slot|lf- A chest with locked-in-place cards is unbreakable
block.enderutilities.jsu.tooltips: - Can only store normally non-stackable items|lf- 270 slots of storage space, max 256 items per stack
enderutilities.gui.label.leaveonefilleds: Leave one filled stack of every item type
enderutilities.gui.label.handybag.shiftc: Shift-click behaviour:|lfmove between inventory and hotbar

enderutilities.gui.infoarea.creation_sta: Crafting presets:|lf- Left click (1st): Load recipe|lf- Left click (2nd): Add an item to the grid|lf- Left Click (3rd): Fill grid up to largest existing stack|lf- Shift + left click: Store recipe|lf- Right click: Clear grid (same as 'x')|lf- Clear the grid (again) when empty to hide the recipe|lf- Middle click: Remove stored recipe|lf- Shift + click the quick move buttons to set the quick|lf  action, which happens on double-left-click on the block|lf- The crafting grid you last interact with|lf (hilighted) is used for JEI recipe filling
